Millionaire Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 12:30am

Ingredients




1 8 oz. cream cheese
1/2 cup sugar
8 ounces pineapple tidbits, drained
1 lg. Cool whip
1 sm. jar maraschino cherries, drained and cut in half
1 cup pecan pieces

Preparation

1 Beat cream cheese and sugar by hand until smooth. Fold in pineapple and Cool Whip, cherries, and pecans. Sprinkle a few pecans on top of finished salad. Refrigerate.
